title: Meta Reportedly Plans To Expand Smart Glasses Push With New Prescription Ray-Ban Models, Targeting Billions Of Everyday Eyewear Users - Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL), Essilorluxottica (OTC:ESLOF)
summary: Meta Platforms, Inc. plans to launch two new Ray-Ban smart glasses for prescription users next week, aiming to tap into the vision correction market. The company's earnings report exceeded expectations, but its stock is currently trending downward.
sentiment_reason: The launch of new products in a growing market segment is neutral to positive, but the downward trend in stock price and negative market news sentiment reflect a neutral overall market impact.
